g.inkscape:label: dims + notes
g.text: A LOW NAME PLATE (slot from the bottom)
B SAIL: tall fin behind the name (no slot on B: A rests against its front edge, toe in front)
Sail variant (sketch, not tooled). Footprint 100 x 92 mm (kite), height 72.
Numeral: cap height 55 mm = 77 mm type, readable along the table from the door; seat/name stay on the low plate A.
COM y 21.6 mm behind A, z 25.9; nearest hull edge 29.4 mm -> tip-over 49 deg (a little under the main D1; heavier sail raises the COM).
A is held against falling backwards by the sail face (gap 0.2) and forwards by its lean + the 2 mm toe step: weakest joint, test first.
Slot in A 10.0 deep, toe/floor of B 9.4 (0.6 gap). Same slot test strip, same pre-coloured lemon board, 400 g.
Sail top edge keeps the dip arc R119.1 (dome / dip echo stays). Nests on SRA3: ~7 sails + 7 plates per sheet (estimate, not drawn).
